h1: Coupons and discounts with clear rules
overview: Discounts work best when the rules are simple and the checkout is clear. We set up coupon codes in your billing provider and add a code field to your checkout. You decide the offer, such as a percentage off, a fixed amount or the first three months free, plus who can use it and when it ends. We test each code, including expired and misused ones, so surprises are avoided.

faq: Can a discount repeat every month or only once?
Both. A coupon can apply once, for a set number of months or forever. We set it up to match your offer and show customers what the price will be after the discount ends.
Can you help prevent code abuse?
Yes. We add limits per customer, expiry dates and maximum uses. Nothing stops every misuse, but these rules keep it contained, and the report shows unusual use.
Not in this service. We set up the discount tools and rules you choose. Email or ad campaigns that promote the codes are separate services you can order.
Does it work with my existing payment provider?
Stripe, Paddle and others have coupon features, with different rules. We check what yours supports first, so your offer does not need a workaround that could confuse customers.
